name_zh: 塔吉克·拉赫蒙：内战与波斯认同水资源博弈
name_en: Tajikistan Rahmon: Civil War & Persian Identity Water Resource Game
description_zh: 埃莫马利·拉赫蒙 (1952-) 塔吉克斯坦总统 (1994-)，1992-1997年塔吉克内战幸存者，重建国家统一，推行波斯语言文化复兴确立区别于乌兹别克的民族认同，在阿姆河流域水资源博弈中捍卫上游国家权益。
description_en: Emomali Rahmon (1952-) Tajikistan President (1994-), 1992-1997 Tajik civil war survivor, rebuilt national unity, promoted Persian language culture revival establishing distinct national identity from Uzbekistan, defended upstream country rights in Amu Darya water resource competition.
reason_zh: 拉赫蒙代表后苏联中亚内战幸存与民族重建的双重挑战，展示了波斯语系小国如何在突厥语系主导区域通过语言文化复兴确立主体性，同时在水资源地缘政治中捍卫生存权益。
reason_en: Rahmon represents post-Soviet Central Asian civil war survival and national reconstruction dual challenge, demonstrating how Persian-language small nation establishes subjectivity through language-culture revival in Turkic-dominated region while defending survival rights in water geopolitics.
steps_zh: 研究拉赫蒙早年集体农庄主席与内战期间生存
分析1997年和平协议签署与国家统一重建
探讨波斯语复兴与阿拉伯字母恢复尝试
评估罗贡水电站与阿姆河水资源外交博弈
总结拉赫蒙长期执政与家族政治化治理模式
steps_en: Study Rahmon early collective farm chairman and civil war survival
Analyze 1997 peace agreement signing and national unity reconstruction
Explore Persian language revival and Arabic script restoration attempt
Evaluate Rogun Dam and Amu Darya water diplomacy game
Summarize Rahmon long-term rule and family politicized governance model
expected_zh: 掌握内战后民族重建与波斯认同复兴双重路径，理解中亚水资源地缘政治上下游博弈逻辑，评估拉赫蒙模式对塔吉克长期稳定的贡献与代价。
expected_en: Master post-civil war national reconstruction and Persian identity revival dual path, understand Central Asian water geopolitics upstream-downstream game logic, evaluate Rahmon model contributions and costs for Tajik long-term stability.
case_zh: 1992-1997 内战10万人亡；1997 和平协议；波斯语官方语言地位；罗贡水电站建设。内战波斯认同水博弈范式永存。
case_en: 1992-1997 civil war 100K dead; 1997 peace agreement; Persian official language status; Rogun Dam construction. Civil war Persian identity water game paradigm endures.
cross_cultural_impact: Civil war survival; Persian identity revival; water diplomacy; upstream rights
